provenance.horizonsUtSemantics: Horizons TIME_TYPE=UT means UT1 before 1962 and UTC from 1962 onward.
provenance.horizons1950InputSemantics: The 1950 proleptic-UTC calendar input is interpreted by Horizons as UT1; no EOP correction is applied.
provenance.swissUtSemantics: Swiss swetest -ut receives the recorded UT calendar/Julian date for house sidereal-time calculation; no DUT1 correction is applied.
